summary: Build practical solar PV design, installation, and commissioning skills in 5 days. Enroll with TrainingCred today.
lede: Solar PV design and installation training covers how to turn site and load data into a workable system layout and commissioning plan. For professionals already involved in solar projects, it develops skills in array sizing and inverter selection, electrical protection and documentation, and commissioning tests and performance monitoring. Practice includes shading and yield analysis, single-line diagrams, installation checklists, and handover records.
audienceIntro: This advanced solar PV system design and installation course is intended for professionals who already work with solar projects and need sharper design, installation, and commissioning capability.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of basic electrical concepts, AC/DC principles, and site safety practices relevant to solar PV system design and installation. Prior experience in solar work is recommended for this advanced course, and familiarity with Microsoft Excel, basic single-line diagrams, and technical datasheets will help you complete the sizing and documentation exercises faster. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a laptop for calculation sheets, design templates, and software-based exercises.
